title: audit-entry
description: Schema for an order audit entry. This is the irrevocable legal record binding a specific trade to the exact canonical package, tenant overrides, mode, and policy checks in effect at signal time. Every field is required. additionalProperties is false everywhere. The canonical_hash, tenant_override_hash, and account_override_hash establish the provenance chain per VERSIONING.md §2.3 and OVERRIDE-SCHEMA.md §8.

audit_id.description: Globally unique audit entry identifier. UUID v4.

timestamp_ns.description: Unix epoch timestamp in nanoseconds when the audit entry was created (signal reception time).

canonical_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical policy package in effect at signal time. Format: sha256:<hex>. Per VERSIONING.md §2.3: no order may be emitted without this field.

tenant_override_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the tenant override file applied, or null if no tenant override was active. Per OVERRIDE-SCHEMA.md §8.

account_override_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the account-level override file applied, or null if no account override was active. Per OVERRIDE-SCHEMA.md §8.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier. Must match a tenant_id in policy.tenancy.yaml#tenants.

strategy_id.description: Strategy identifier that generated the signal.

mode.description: Active operating mode at signal time. Enum from promotion stages (M-01). Must match policy.runtime.yaml#mode.active at signal time.

signal.description: The trading signal that initiated this order.

intent_quantity.description: Intended quantity at signal time (before sizing adjustments).

intent_price.description: Intended entry price at signal time.

rationale_ref.description: Reference to the signal rationale document, strategy run ID, or replay identifier.

order.description: The order as constructed and submitted.

cl_ord_id.description: Client order identifier. Globally unique within tenant.

venue.description: Trading venue the order was routed to.

quantity.description: Order quantity after sizing engine adjustments.

price.description: Limit price for LIMIT/STOP_LIMIT/MARKETABLE_LIMIT orders. 0 for MARKET orders.

stop_price.description: Stop price for STOP or STOP_LIMIT orders. Omitted for other order types.

risk_check.description: Snapshot of risk check inputs and verdict at order submission time.

heat_before_pct.description: Portfolio heat as decimal fraction immediately before this order.

heat_after_pct.description: Projected portfolio heat as decimal fraction after this order fills.

cluster_before_pct.description: Symbol cluster concentration as decimal fraction before this order.

cluster_after_pct.description: Projected symbol cluster concentration as decimal fraction after this order fills.

verdict.description: Risk engine verdict for this order.

modification_applied.description: Description of any size or price modification applied on verdict=modify.

compliance_check.description: Snapshot of compliance check results at order submission time.

reg_sho_ok.description: Reg SHO locate check passed (or not applicable).

restricted_list_ok.description: Symbol was not on restricted list at check time.

mwcb_state.description: Active MWCB level at order time, or null if no MWCB halt was active.

luld_state.description: Active LULD state at order time: 'halt' if in LULD band halt, 'limit_up', 'limit_down', or 'none'.

data_quality_snapshot.description: Snapshot of data quality metrics at order submission time.

feed_age_ms.description: Age of the primary data feed in milliseconds at order time.

cross_venue_spread_bps.description: Cross-venue price disagreement in basis points at order time.

nbbo_available.description: Whether valid NBBO data was available at order time.

lifecycle.description: Ordered array of order state transitions with timestamps.

timestamp_ns.description: Unix epoch nanoseconds of this state transition.

fills.description: Array of fill (execution) records. Empty array if order was cancelled/rejected before any fill.

price.description: Execution price for this fill leg.

timestamp_ns.description: Unix epoch nanoseconds of this fill (exchange time if available, else system time).

final_state.description: Terminal order state. Must be one of the terminal states from policy.order-lifecycle.yaml#states.

operator_kill_state_snapshot.description: Snapshot of the operator kill-switch state at order submission time. Per OVERRIDE-SCHEMA.md §7.

trading_paused.description: Whether global trading was paused at order time.

flattening_mode.description: Active flattening mode at order time.

per_tenant_paused.description: Whether this specific tenant's trading was paused at order time.
